maxRepairs.description:
Repairs this contract authorizes after a protected rejection.

The first candidate is not a repair, so the node runs at most `maxRepairs + 1` candidate generations. An absent bound authorizes no remediation at all: a rejection is terminal. `FACTORY_LIMITS.maxCandidateGenerations` caps every domain at three generations.
